title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-08-17
content:
Date: 2026-08-17
Time: 10:00-11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #eng-all-hands
Facilitator: Asha Patel
Scribe: Miguel Torres

Attendees:
- Asha Patel (serving-runtime)
- Miguel Torres (platform-engineering)
- Emily Wong (observability)
- Ravi Singh (infrastructure)
- Leah Kim (release-engineering)
- Tom Brooks (private-deployments)
- Sofia Martinez (product-hosted-api)
- + several engineers joined for specific agenda items

Absentees:
- N/A (informal heads-up: Jason out next week)

Agenda:
1) Quick wins / highlights (5m)
2) Incident & reliability review (10m)
3) Progress updates by area (serving-runtime, infra, observability, private) (25m)
4) Upcoming releases + rollout plan (10m)
5) Resource / capacity planning + autoscaler work (5m)
6) Action items & blockers (5m)

Summary / High-level:
- Overall: Most projects on track for August milestones. Two items flagged as higher risk: quantization perf regression seen in nightly benchmarks and autoscaler instability causing transient capacity drops for Dedicated pools.
- Decision: Prioritize a short hotfix for the quantization regression (target patch release next week) and schedule a deep-dive on the autoscaler mid-week to lock down root cause.

Incident & Reliability:
- KV cache memory leak (incident ENGINF-3421): ongoing triage. Repro path narrowed to sequence eviction edge case when prefix caching + long-lived sessions (>45 minutes) combine. Patch in review (PR 789) reduces the window; prod canary looks good in EU region.
  - Owner: Miguel Torres
  - Status: PR in review, canary running in eu-west-1, monitoring for 24h
- Autoscaler flapping (INFRA-588): observed repeated scale-down/scale-up cycles in dedicated pools when burst traffic patterns hit threshold. Potential causes: recent target tracking change (commit f32b) + delayed metrics ingestion.
  - Owner: Ravi Singh
  - Status: rollback of target-tracking change staged for canary tomorrow; additional tracing enabled.

Serving-runtime updates:
- v2.3 quantization work: nightly benchmarks show p95 latency regression ~8% for 8-bit pathway on long prompts. Root suspected in new kernel reorder for AVX512 paths.
  - Immediate plan: revert kernel reorder change in v2.3-hotfix branch; run full benchmark suite.
  - Owner: Leah Kim + low-level team (Paul, Jana)
- Feature: structured output / tool-calling improvements on streaming API progressing; alpha tests with two customers show expected latency improvements when streaming enabled.
  - Owner: Asha Patel
- KV cache improvements: temporary mitigation live in canary (reduces memory growth by dropping stale sessions earlier). Need post-mortem next week to cover long-lived session use-cases.
  - Owner: Miguel Torres

Observability & SLOs:
- New per-route token billing telemetry rollout completed for 3 customers; data looks clean. Observability team working on dashboard for cost-per-inference by model+route.
  - Note: retention costs rising from debug traces — product asked to limit debug retention for non-critical routes.
  - Owner: Emily Wong
- Alert fatigue: team to consolidate noisy autoscaler/scale events into a summarized alert (reduce pager load).

Infrastructure & Capacity:
- Capacity: GPU utilization steady at 72% across hosted pools; Dedicated utilization variable (40-85%) depending on customer patterns. 
- Autoscaler deep-dive scheduled Wednesday 1400 PT; attendees: Ravi, Tom, Leah, infra SREs. Goal: identify race conditions and produce mitigation plan (immediate patch + longer term rework).
  - Action: Ravi to present flamegraphs and metric timelines in the deep-dive.
- Cost: cloud spend spike noted last 3 days due to accidental test traffic from partner integration; cost team applied quota limit. Need clearer guardrails for partner sandbox accounts.

Private deployments:
- On-prem customer X: deployment completed, but onboarding hit a performance delta vs hosted (higher p50 by ~12ms). Likely due to kernel mismatch and CPU affinity. Private-deployments team to lend kernel tuning playbook.
  - Owner: Tom Brooks
- VPC control plane: delayed by one sprint due to security review; new ETA: 2026-09-07.

Release engineering & Roadmap:
- Release cadence: aiming for hotfix release next week for quantization regression; full v2.3 stable release target unchanged for end of August pending validation.
- Canary policy update: start ~2% traffic step-up with 1h observation per step for memory-sensitive changes. Leah will update release playbook.
  - Owner: Leah Kim

Product / GTM notes:
- Product requested conservative messaging for Dedicated customers around autoscaler instability; communications draft needed if issues persist.
  - Owner: Sofia Martinez (draft by EOD Wednesday)

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Miguel: merge KV cache leak hotfix (PR 789) and monitor canary for 24h — due 2026-08-18
- Leah: revert kernel reorder change in v2.3-hotfix branch and run full perf suite — due 2026-08-18
- Ravi: run autoscaler deep-dive and produce short action plan (patch + long-term design) — deep-dive scheduled 2026-08-19; action plan by 2026-08-21
- Emily: consolidate autoscaler alerts and create summarized alerting flow to reduce pager noise — due 2026-08-20
- Tom: provide kernel tuning playbook to Private deployments and customer X on-prem team — due 2026-08-20
- Sofia: draft customer-facing comms about Dedicated autoscaler risk (if needed) — draft by 2026-08-19
- Asha: coordinate PT/QA for streaming structured-output alpha test with two customers and collect feedback — due 2026-08-24

Blockers / Questions:
- Do we have capacity to run the full v2.3 perf suite in parallel with other benchmarks this week? (Leah) -- Miguel to allocate one QA node and confirm by EOD.
- Should we tighten canary rollout policy for memory-sensitive changes? Consensus: temporary tighten until leak fully addressed. Leah to update playbook.

Decisions made:
- Hotfix prioritized for quantization regression; hotfix release planned next week if benchmarks validate.
- Autoscaler rollback of target-tracking change to proceed on canary while deep-dive runs.

Notes / To-do / Brainstorming scraps:
- Quick idea: add a per-deployment memory-safety gate at admission time to prevent extremely long-lived sessions from consuming unlimited cache. Need design doc. (Ravi/Miguel)
- Reminder: quarterly on-call schedule rotation begins 2026-09-01 — confirm handoffs by 2026-08-25.
- Internal: we should add cost alerts for unexpected test traffic from partner sandboxes. Short-term: enforce per-account quota; long-term: automated sandbox cost anomaly detection (possible Optimize integration).

Next meeting: 2026-08-24 10:00 PT

Scribe notes appended: Miguel — added reproduction steps for KV leak and flamegraph links (see linked_artifacts).
